faq_heading: Homes near Peace Arch Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Peace Arch Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Peace Arch Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Peace Arch Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Peace Arch Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 114 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,460,000, townhomes $790,000, condos $590,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Peace Arch Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Peace Arch Elementary the median was 34 days on the market, closing at 96.5% of the list price, with 9% of sales above the list price for the 114 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Peace Arch Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Earl Marriott Secondary (0.7 km north), South Meridian Elementary (0.7 km east) and White Rock Elementary (1.3 km west).

Peace Arch Elementary is an elementary school in White Rock (Surrey School District), at 15877 Roper Ave. It teaches grades K to 7. Programs listed: Early French Immersion.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Peace Arch Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Peace Arch Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Peace Arch Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Peace Arch Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 114 homes sold within 1 km of Peace Arch Elementary: 63 houses, 31 townhomes and 9 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,460,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Peace Arch Elementary

12 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Peace Arch Elementary in a straight line (6 elementary, 3 secondary, 3 other; 5 independent). The closest is Earl Marriott Secondary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Star of the Sea, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is South Meridian Elementary (0.7 km); the nearest independent school is St John Paul II Academy (1.3 km). Other elementary schools close by: South Meridian Elementary (0.7 km east), White Rock Elementary (1.3 km west), Jessie Lee Elementary (1.8 km north-west), H T Thrift Elementary (2.4 km west), Edgewood Elementary (2.5 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is South Meridian Elementary, 0.7 km east of Peace Arch Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Peace Arch Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Peace Arch Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Peace Arch Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Peace Arch Elementary was $1,460,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at South Meridian Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.7 km east of Peace Arch Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
